questions.text: How do I manage my business schedule?
questions.answer: You can manage your business schedule through the event management feature.

questions.text: How do I create an event?
questions.answer: Open **Events**, click **New event**, fill in the title, date, time and location, then click **Save**.

questions.text: How do I edit an event?
questions.answer: Open **Events**, find the event in the list or calendar, click **Edit**, change the details and click **Save**.

questions.text: How do I delete an event?
questions.answer: Open **Events**, click the **⋯** menu on the event, choose **Delete** and confirm.
